project_name: HBOT CLINIC - Hiperbarik Oksijen Tedavisi ve Kronik Yara Bütüncül Hasta Yönetim Sistemi
theme: Light theme default with high contrast medical mode support

clinical_dashboard.kpi_cards: col-span-12 sm:col-span-6 lg:col-span-3 border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm hover:border-teal-500 transition-all cursor-pointer
clinical_dashboard.data_density: High density, zero wasted space, fast scanning for doctors and nurses

patient_kiosk_wizard.container: max-w-4xl mx-auto min-h-[85vh] flex flex-col justify-between p-6 sm:p-10 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xl
patient_kiosk_wizard.touch_targets: min-h-[64px] text-lg sm:text-xl rounded-xl px-8 py-4 font-bold tracking-wide flex items-center justify-center gap-3
patient_kiosk_wizard.step_indicator: Big visual progress bar with numbered steps and clear status labels

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-xl shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
visual_enhancers.glass_header: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-40
visual_enhancers.status_badges: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold
visual_enhancers.safety_banner: p-4 rounded-xl border-l-4 bg-red-50 border-red-600 text-red-900 flex items-start gap-3 shadow-xs font-medium

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, KPI cards, form inputs, navigation items, tabs, and action buttons MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid="kpi-card-appointments", data-testid="anamnesis-next-btn").
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA compliant. Red critical text must always sit on background with >= 4.5:1 ratio.
testing_and_accessibility.kiosk_accessibility: Minimum font size 18px for body and 24px for option buttons in kiosk mode. High hit target radius.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Turkish / English language toggle is readily accessible in top header bar across all roles.
Support role switching (Super Admin, Clinic Admin, Doctor, Nurse, Secretary, Patient) seamlessly via standard avatar menu or role switcher bar.
Patient Anamnesis Kiosk mode must feel uncluttered, large, bold, step-indexed with clear Save & Continue actions.
Clinical dashboard for doctors must pack critical information (HBOT session live status, wound healing trajectory chart, risk alerts, missing consents) without feeling overwhelming.
Integrate TIME model (Tissue, Infection/Inflammation, Moisture, Edge) and Diabetic Foot Assessment module into the Wound Tracking workspace.
Always apply data-testid attributes on form elements and action buttons.
